prompt.alinti: Forget using Claude at 10% because right now, Opus is spending most of your limit on stuff Haiku could do.
Right now Opus does everything on your account, even renaming a file, and that eats your limit the same as the hard stuff.

Haiku 5.5 is 10 cents per million tokens, where the last Haiku was a dollar, so the easy stuff barely touches your limit.
I've been running it for a week and I haven't hit the wall once.
Comment ‘OPUS’ and I’ll send you the skill.
